items.name: Exp. Share

items.name: Coin Case

items.name: Seal Case

items.name: Poffin Case

items.name: Fashion Case
items.desc: Em Jubilife City, de presente depois de expulsar a Team Galactic de lá.

en.desc: Jubilife City (gift after the player has defeated Team Galactic there)

items.name: Pal Pad
items.desc: No subsolo de qualquer Centro Pokémon, com a atendente, depois da insígnia de Oreburgh.

items.name: Point Card
items.desc: Ao entrar no Battle Park pela primeira vez.

en.desc: Twinleaf Town (from Johanna)

items.name: Amulet Coin
items.desc: No subsolo da Goldenrod Department Store.

en.desc: Goldenrod Department Store Basement

en.desc: New Bark Town (from Professor Elm after earning all eight Johto Badges) / Goldenrod Radio Tower (match all 5 digits in the Lucky Channel)

items.name: Vs. Recorder
items.desc: Na guarita da Rota 31, com o Ethan/Lyra.

items.desc: No Centro Pokémon da Rota 32, com um Pescador.

items.name: Good Rod
items.desc: Em Olivine City, com um Pescador.

items.name: Super Rod
items.desc: Na Rota 12, com os Irmãos Pescadores.

en.desc: Route 12 (from Fishing Brothers)

items.name: Bicycle

en.desc: Ecruteak City (from a person in a house next to the Gym)

en.desc: Goldenrod City Flower Shop (after defeating Whitney)

items.name: Pass

en.desc: Saffron City (from Copycat after returning the Lost Item)

items.name: S.S. Ticket
items.desc: Em New Bark Town, com o Professor Elm, depois de entrar no Hall da Fama.

en.desc: New Bark Town (from Professor Elm after entering the Hall of Fame)

items.name: Mystery Egg
items.desc: Na Rota 30, com o Mr. Pokémon. É o ovo do Togepi.

en.desc: Route 30 (from Mr. Pokémon)

items.name: Red Scale
items.desc: No Lake of Rage, ao capturar ou derrotar o Gyarados vermelho.

en.desc: Lake of Rage (after capturing or defeating the Red Gyarados)

items.name: Card Key
items.desc: No Goldenrod Tunnel, com o diretor da rádio, depois de resgatá-lo.

en.desc: Goldenrod Tunnel (from director after rescuing him)

items.name: Basement Key
items.desc: Na Goldenrod Radio Tower, tomada do Petrel depois de vencê-lo.

en.desc: Goldenrod Radio Tower (taken from Petrel after defeating him)

items.name: Machine Part
items.desc: Escondida no Ginásio de Cerulean, dentro de uma das boias da fileira mais próxima do pedestal da Misty.

en.desc: Cerulean Gym (hidden inside one of the flotation tubes in the row of tubes closest to Misty's pedestal)

items.name: Lost Item

en.desc: Vermilion City Pokémon Fan Club (from a club member after hearing about Copycat's missing doll)

items.name: Secret Potion

en.desc: Cianwood City (from pharmacist)

items.name: Rainbow Wing

en.desc: Goldenrod Radio Tower (from director after saving the tower from Team Rocket) / Pewter City (from an old man near the entrance to Route 3)

items.name: Silver Wing
items.desc: Com o diretor da Goldenrod Radio Tower, depois de livrar a torre da Team Rocket, ou com o velho perto da entrada da Rota 3, em Pewter City — qual dos dois depende da versão. Chama o Lugia nas Whirl Islands.

en.desc: Goldenrod Radio Tower (from director after saving the tower from Team Rocket) / Pewter City (from an old man near the entrance to Route 3)

items.name: Clear Bell

en.desc: Ecruteak City (reward for defeating the Kimono Girls)

items.name: Tidal Bell
items.desc: Em Ecruteak City, por vencer as Kimono Girls. Em SoulSilver, ela e a Silver Wing são as duas exigidas para o Lugia aparecer.

en.desc: Ecruteak City (reward for defeating the Kimono Girls)

items.name: Red Orb
items.desc: Na Rota 30, com o Mr. Pokémon, depois da Pokédex Nacional e de pegar um inicial de Kanto com o Professor Oak. Chama o Kyogre na Embedded Tower.

en.desc: Route 30 (from Mr. Pokémon after both the National Pokédex and a Kanto first partner Pokémon has been obtained from Professor Oak).

items.name: Blue Orb
items.desc: Na Rota 30, com o Mr. Pokémon, depois da Pokédex Nacional e de pegar um inicial de Kanto com o Professor Oak. Chama o Groudon na Embedded Tower.

en.desc: Route 30 (from Mr. Pokémon after both the National Pokédex and a Kanto first partner Pokémon has been obtained from Professor Oak).

items.name: Jade Orb
items.desc: Em Pallet Town, com o Professor Oak, mostrando a ele um Kyogre e um Groudon capturados em HeartGold ou SoulSilver. Chama o Rayquaza.

en.desc: Pallet Town (from Professor Oak if he is shown a Kyogre from HeartGold and SoulSilver and a Groudon from HeartGold and SoulSilver)

items.name: Enigma Stone
items.desc: Só por evento de Mystery Gift. Leva ao Latias ou ao Latios, conforme a versão.

en.desc: Available only by Mystery Gift event

items.name: Coin Case
items.desc: Com o Mr. Game, no Game Corner de Goldenrod ou de Celadon. Na versão japonesa, fica no trecho sul do Goldenrod Tunnel.

en.desc: Goldenrod Game Corner or Celadon Game Corner (from Mr. Game)* / Goldenrod Tunnel (southern part)*

items.name: Apricorn Box
items.desc: Na Rota 30, na casa mais perto de Cherrygrove City. Guarda os Apricorns que viram Poké Ball.

en.desc: Route 30 (house closest to Cherrygrove City)

items.name: Berry Pots
items.desc: Na Rota 36, com a funcionária da floricultura, por capturar ou derrotar o Sudowoodo. Planta baga em qualquer lugar.

en.desc: Route 36 (from a flower shop employee for catching or defeating Sudowoodo)

items.name: Blue Card
items.desc: Na Goldenrod Radio Tower, com a Buena. Junta pontos no programa dela.

en.desc: Goldenrod Radio Tower (from Buena)

items.name: GB Sounds
items.desc: Nos Celadon Condominiums, com o funcionário da Game Freak em frente ao globo, depois das 16 insígnias. Troca a trilha pela do Game Boy.

en.desc: Celadon Condominiums (from the Game Freak employee in front of the globe after obtaining all 16 Badges)

items.name: Unown Report
items.desc: Nas Ruins of Alph, depois de resolver o primeiro quebra-cabeça de parede.

en.desc: Ruins of Alph (after solving the first wall puzzle)

items.name: Rage Candy Bar
items.desc: Comprada em Mahogany Town, com o homem que barra o caminho para a Rota 44.

en.desc: Mahogany Town (purchase from man who stops the player from going to Route 44)
